pageCache.pageTitle: Clubs/Wraparound Care | Oakley Church of England Combined School
pageCache.text:
Clubs/Wraparound Care
Our After School Club runs from Monday to Thursday, 3.20pm to 4.20pm.
Oakley Pre-School offer a Sunset Club from 4.20pm to 6.00pm for those needing slightly longer childcare.
On Fridays Oakley Pre-School will run after school care from 3.20pm through to 6.00pm. Please contact them directly to book this and Sunset Club.
From 3.20pm to 4.20pm we offer a structured session which is either sports, educational or arts and crafts based.
Monday- Circuits and Drills £44 per term (8 sessions)
Tuesday- Hand Signing £44 per term (8 sessions)
KS2 Forest School (Ad-Hoc only)
Wednesday- Chill Club £38.50 per term (7 sessions)
Thursday- Arts and Crafts £38.50 per term (7 sessions)
All our clubs are £6.80 per Ad-Hoc session or a reduced fee of £5.50 per week when booking a full term. If booking per term please make the booking before the day of the first session.
When paying using Tax Free Vouchers, please book via the office.
Afterschool Club Timetable
Long Jump/ Shot Putt/ Athletic Skills
Athletics- Cross Country
Please read our After School Club Terms and Conditions
Breakfast and Sunset Clubs
A Breakfast Club is run by Oakley Pre-School every morning from 7.30am through to 8.40am. Children are given breakfast and kept busy until going to their classrooms at 8.40am.
Sunset Club is also run by Oakley Pre-School staff and is available Monday to Thursday 4.20pm (after our After School Clubs finish) to 6.00pm and on Fridays from 3.20pm to 6.00pm.
For full details please contact the Pre-School directly on 07791 226473 or email preschool@oakley.bucks.sch.uk

pageCache.pageTitle: Personal Passports | Oakley Church of England Combined School
pageCache.text:
Personal Passports
We are excited to share with you a new initiative at Oakley School: our “Personal Development Passports” – also known as the “Passport to becoming a Mighty Oak.”
Each child will receive their passport when they start at Oakley C of E Combined School, and it will remain with them throughout their journey up to Year 6. These passports are closely linked to our school vision and values of Love, Honesty, and Respect and are designed to support children in developing essential life skills, wellbeing, and emotional awareness.
Inside the passport, your child will find a variety of activities and challenges that encourage wellbeing, emotional growth, engagement in well-rounded opportunities, and, most importantly, fun! Our teachers are thrilled to begin completing these activities with the children as the year progresses, helping each child grow into a confident, caring, and resilient “Mighty Oak.”
While the passports are staying in school, and children will be completing the activities during the school day, we warmly invite you to find out more by visiting our school website or next time you are in the school building looking at the information board in the corridor next to the playground.

pageCache.text:
Governors
Welcome to our Governors’ section
Welcome to Oakley Combined School governor pages. On this page you will find further information on our Governors and the role we play in school. We act as a critical friend for the school and provide support and challenge to ensure the best possible outcomes are reached for all children who attend the school.
We work with the Headteacher to set the strategic vision. We also oversee the financial performance of the school to make sure its money is well spent. All staff and governors work together with the common aim of providing a safe and vibrant learning environment in which all can reach their potential.
We are very proud of the school and remain committed to ensuring that children have a balanced, broad and stimulating experience during their time at Oakley. As parents and carers, you are very much part of the whole school community and your opinions and comments are very valuable to us.

pageCache.pageTitle: SEND | Oakley Church of England Combined School
pageCache.text:
SEND
Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND)
Our Vision for Inclusion
At our school, we believe that every child is a unique acorn with the potential to grow into a mighty oak. Through an inclusive, nurturing, and ambitious environment, we ensure that all children are valued, respected, and supported to flourish emotionally, academically, socially, and personally.
We celebrate diversity and recognise that every child learns and develops in their own way. By removing barriers to learning, promoting equality of opportunity, and fostering a strong sense of belonging, we enable every pupil to grow in confidence, resilience, and independence.
Working in partnership with families, staff, other professionals and the wider community, we cultivate a culture where differences are embraced, strengths are recognised, and every child feels safe, heard, and empowered to achieve their full potential.
Together, we help all our little acorns grow into mighty oaks.
If you wish to discuss your child, please do not hesitate to get in touch with your child's class teacher or with Mrs Hall (Inclusion Lead & SENDCo).
Email: sendco@oakley.bucks.sch.uk
Telephone: 01844 238364
